issues.problem: 26A42 is the code for Riemann/Stieltjes/Lebesgue integration theory, not for applications of the one-variable integral.
Stewart chapter/section numbers (Ch. 6, §8.1) depend on the edition.
Over length; some duplicated warnings (|f-g| and washer formula said in text and again in pitfalls).
issues.fix: Trimmed intro, recipe, arc-length and connection prose; removed the duplicates.

issues.problem: Direction of travel of x=t^2, y=t^3-3t was reversed: the curve comes in from the lower right (y -> -oo as t -> -oo) and leaves to the upper right, not the other way.
issues.fix: Rewrote the description with the points (1,2), origin, (1,-2) in order; added a check.

issues.problem: Stated for any continuous f with beta-alpha <= 2pi; when f changes sign, traced pieces can overlap (e.g. cos 3theta on [0,2pi] covers each petal twice), so 'the region swept has area (1/2)int f^2' is false.
issues.fix: Added the hypothesis f >= 0 and used f (not |f|) in the proof; the sign-change cases stay in the pitfall.

issues.problem: 'The lower branch is concave up and the upper branch concave down' is wrong: the t>0 half also contains the part beyond the crossing with y>0.
issues.fix: Described the halves by t>0 and t<0 (mirror images).

issues.problem: 'Length from theta=0 to T is sqrt2(e^T-1)' combined with T -> -oo gives a negative length.
issues.fix: Restated as the length on [T,0], sqrt2(1-e^T); added a check.

issues.problem: 'never pass through the same vertical line twice' is garbled.
issues.fix: 'meets each vertical line at most once'.

issues.problem: Stewart chapter number is edition dependent.
'every solution is e^{At}x(0)' right after introducing x'=Ax+g(t): false for the forced system.
Normal-mode frequencies are square roots of eigenvalues of M^{-1}K, not of the stiffness matrix alone (unless all masses are 1).
P(t)=e^{tQ} as stated needs a finite state space.
'If 0 is an eigenvalue, try a particular solution with a factor of t' is not a reliable rule.
issues.fix: Replaced by: there may be no equilibrium; find a particular solution another way (variation of parameters).

issues.problem: Complex-eigenvalue item was vague.
Boyce chapter number varies (7 in most editions, 6 in the 12th international adaptation).
'the substitution x=e^{-t} relates it to the Mellin transform': that substitution turns the Mellin transform into the two-sided Laplace transform, not the one-sided one on this page.
issues.fix: Stated precisely; added a numeric check (Gamma(5/2) both ways).

issues.problem: Exercise 4 (integral equation, sinh t) unchecked.
'For x>0 the solutions grow very fast' is false for Ai, which decays.
issues.fix: Said almost every solution grows, Ai (up to a constant factor) decays; added an mpmath check.

issues.problem: Convergence radius stated only for y1; the explanation of the logarithm in case 3 (equal roots) via the recurrence breaking down at n=r1-r2=0 was muddled.
issues.fix: Stated convergence for all series; separate explanation for case 3 and case 4.

issues.problem: 'only J0 appears in the vibrations of a drum' is only true for radially symmetric modes.
'denominators do not vanish' needs lowest terms.
34A25 and 33C10 checked: 34A25 = analytical theory of ODEs (series, transforms); 33C10 = Bessel and Airy functions. Both apply.
Boyce chapter number and title vary by edition.
The '= 0' in Lagrange's identity holds only when u, v satisfy the boundary conditions, and L was undefined in the entry.
issues.fix: Defined L and added the condition.

issues.problem: Spectral properties stated without 'regular'/bounded interval (they fail for singular problems, as the lesson itself says).
Reduction of a2y''+a1y'+a0y+lambda a3 y=0 to SL form needs a3>0 for a positive weight; p, q, w were not identified.
issues.fix: Added a3>0 and p=mu a2, q=-mu a0, w=mu a3; added a symbolic check.

issues.problem: The inverse of L exists only if 0 is not an eigenvalue.
issues.fix: Added the shift of q; same caveat in the functional-analysis link.

issues.problem: 'R compares potential energy with kinetic energy' is loose.
34B24 (Sturm-Liouville theory) and 34L10 (eigenfunctions, eigenfunction expansions, completeness) checked.
Boyce chapter number varies by edition.
Spiral/node remark tied to 'F twice differentiable', and gave no warning about repeated eigenvalues.
issues.fix: Rewritten: the homeomorphism does not separate nodes from spirals; spirals stay spirals and nodes with distinct eigenvalues stay nodes; only a repeated real eigenvalue lets a node become a spiral (cf. Boyce's locally linear table).

issues.problem: Said nodes occupy open regions of the trace-determinant plane (false on the parabola tau^2=4Delta), and that a centre is pushed to a spiral (it may also stay a centre); presented as an argument rather than a heuristic.
issues.fix: Rewritten as a labelled heuristic with both borderline cases.
